name: astra-orchestrator
tagline_zh: 改一个函数却要翻遍半个仓库？让 root 先出计划，Luna 并行探路、写码、跑测试。
tagline_en: Stop grepping half the repo for a one-line fix. Root plans, Luna explores and builds in parallel, Astra reviews.
desc_en: Orchestrate complex Codex coding work with the root agent as planner/integrator, Luna subagents for exploration, implementation, testing, and research, and an Astra reviewer. Use for multi-file features, debugging across components, repo-wide changes, parallelizable workstreams, or whenever the user asks to delegate or use subagents. Do not use for trivial one-file edits or simple questions.
why_zh: 分工写死在角色里：探索、实现、测试、调研各归 Luna，验收归 Astra，root 只做计划与集成。
why_en: Roles are hard-wired: Luna explores, implements, tests, researches; Astra reviews; root only plans and integrates — no model.
limit_zh: 只在 Codex 环境里跑，需要能起子智能体；单文件小改和简单问答它会直接拒绝。
limit_en: Codex-only and needs subagent support; it refuses trivial one-file edits and simple questions, so forcing it just burns tokens for a slower answer.
title_en: Codex multi-agent pipeline: root plans, Luna builds, Astra.
